title: 銀華の柩と、星屑を掬う空飛ぶ蒐集船
author: 硝子 シオン

en.title: The Silver-Blossom Casket and the Sky-Sailing Ship of Stardust
en.premise: The world was a glass cage enveloped in eternal twilight, where spilled memories drifted like gemstones. I am the guardian of the archives, a place smelling of old books, tucked away in a corner of a massive collection ship sailing across a sea of clouds. One night, I discovered crimson droplets overflowing from a page—crystals of a passion once loved and then broken. The moment I touched that beauty, a faint crack formed in my soul, drawing me toward a stardust-like oblivion. Before I shatter, I must claim the most fragile gemstone of all: the truth of this world.

zh.title: 銀華之柩與掬起星屑的飛行搜集船
zh.premise: 世界是一座被永恆薄明籠罩的玻璃囚籠，散落的記憶化作寶石在此漂浮。我是穿梭於雲海之上的巨大搜集船上，一名守候在充滿古書香氣的書庫角落的守門人。某個夜晚，我發現頁間溢出了真紅色的水滴——那是曾經被某人深愛、卻又被其親手摧毀的情熱結晶。在觸碰到那份美麗的瞬間，我的靈魂刻下了微小的裂痕，被如星屑般的遺忘之海所吸引。在徹底破碎之前，我必須將那顆名為「世界真相」的最脆弱寶石，握在手中。
